name: Unlock selling exhaustion rebound
hypothesis: Buy after unlocked-cohort net selling declines and price reclaims a base with adequate liquidity.
spec: Setup: A scheduled unlock can create temporary inventory pressure. Entry: Buy after unlocked-cohort net selling declines and price reclaims a base with adequate liquidity. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below the base or on renewed cohort distribution. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable.
